description: Add prepaid balance. Lightning: pass amount_sats (minimum 100) to get an invoice; pay it, then call again with payment_hash (or GET the check_url) to credit the account. USDC on Base (x402): pass amount_usd (minimum 0.10) to get the payment requirements, sign accepts[0], then call again with the same amount_usd plus x402_payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']); your USDC is settled first and the receipt is in _meta['x402/payment-response']. USDC funds pay deliveries at USDC list prices, sats funds at sats prices. Feeds paused for zero balance resume automatically after credit.

amount_usd.description: USDC to add over x402 (0.10 to 50), e.g. "1.00".

bitfeed_token.description: BitChime account token (btf_…). Also accepted as Authorization: Bearer. Omit on the first create_feed to open an account; the token is returned once.

payment_hash.description: Optional. If set, check this invoice instead of creating one.

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.

name: topup
title: BitChime top-up (Lightning or USDC)
